hero.title: De Machinedokters
hero.subtitle: Faster. Better. Forward.
hero.lead: Process optimisation, fault analysis, retrofit, robotics, special-purpose machines and CE marking for existing and new production lines. For factories in Örebro, Värmland and Västmanland counties.

intro.line1: Full speed ahead for your production: why buy new machines when you can make the current ones perform better?
intro.line2: An optimised factory: higher OEE, less dependence on staff and higher profit.
intro.quote: "Others see a problem, we see a challenge. And we solve it."

items.title: Tailor-made engineering
items.text:
Every factory is different, so every process needs its own approach. De Machinedokters improve existing machines with smart technical modifications, without expensive replacement or off-the-shelf solutions.

With upgrades and smart modifications we get more capacity and reliability out of what is already on your floor.

items.title: Fast ROI
items.text:
We do not believe in long projects or thick reports. We are known for creative solutions that can be carried out quickly: practical improvements that deliver results straight away.

We do not make problems bigger than they are.

items.title: Personal approach
items.text:
We do not stand on the sidelines telling you how it should be done. We are in the factory, working with operators, technicians and managers.

That keeps lines of communication short and produces solutions that fit daily practice. Because we involve the team in the changes, the knowledge stays on the shop floor and the result lasts.

symptoms.title: Complaints De Machinedokters cure
symptoms.intro: Every factory has complaints now and then: machines that underperform, production lines that stop or processes that run stiffly. De Machinedokters make the right diagnosis and deliver a lasting solution. Typical complaints you call us in for:
symptoms.quote: "Stubborn machine? Perfect. That is our speciality."

items.title: Inefficient production process
items.text: Your machines run below capacity and output per hour is lower than it should be. Take our customer Coca-Cola, where we optimised the can process. Thanks to our solutions the new line runs 30% faster!
items.imageAlt: Automated production line with small empty bottles on a conveyor in a factory.

items.title: High downtime and maintenance costs
items.text: Unexpected breakdowns and high maintenance costs hit profit directly. Every minute of downtime is lost production. At Coca-Cola we achieved 40% fewer breakdowns.
items.imageAlt: Industrial conveyor system with roller tracks, yellow railings and control panels in a factory hall.

items.title: Heavy dependence on staff
items.text: A shortage of staff is more and more often the bottleneck of a business. De Machinedokters create smarter, more automated processes. Among other things, we helped a food company automate tasks, giving it 20% faster packaging speed.
items.imageAlt: Technician on the floor next to orange industrial robots.

about.title: About us
about.text:
At De Machinedokters everything revolves around making things run better. Literally.
We are technical problem solvers who improve existing machines and processes with smart, durable modifications. No thick reports or standard solutions, but practical work that delivers straight away.

Since 2018 we have been helping factories produce more efficiently and building special-purpose machines. That experience taught us that many machines do not need replacing. They just need the right treatment.
